tree.heading: In general
tree.text: In conducting a feasibility study for a project (or a component of a project) for ecosystem restoration, the Secretary shall ensure that the recommended project includes, as an integral part of the project, a plan for monitoring the success of the ecosystem restoration.

children.text: include a description of the monitoring activities to be carried out, the criteria for ecosystem restoration success, and the estimated cost and duration of the monitoring; and
specify that the monitoring shall continue until such time as the Secretary determines that the criteria for ecosystem restoration success will be met.

tree.heading: Cost share
tree.text: For a period of 10 years from completion of construction of a project (or a component of a project) for ecosystem restoration, the Secretary shall consider the cost of carrying out the monitoring as a project cost. If the monitoring plan under subsection (b) requires monitoring beyond the 10-year period, the cost of monitoring shall be a non-Federal responsibility.

tree.heading: Inclusions
tree.text: A monitoring plan under subsection (b) shall include a description of—

children.text: the types and number of restoration activities to be conducted;
the physical action to be undertaken to achieve the restoration objectives of the project;
the functions and values that will result from the restoration plan; and

a contingency plan for taking corrective actions in cases in which monitoring demonstrates that restoration measures are not achieving ecological success in accordance with criteria described in the monitoring plan.

tree.heading: Conclusion of operation and maintenance responsibility
tree.text: The responsibility of a non-Federal interest for operation and maintenance of the nonstructural and nonmechanical elements of a project, or a component of a project, for ecosystem restoration shall cease 10 years after the date on which the Secretary makes a determination of success under subsection (b)(2).

tree.heading: Federal obligations
tree.text: The Secretary is not responsible for the operation or maintenance of any components of a project with respect to which a non-Federal interest is released from obligations under subsection (e).

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 2007, and not as part of the Water Resources Development Act of 1986 which comprises this chapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2016—Subsecs. (d) to (f). Pub. L. 114–322 added subsecs. (d) to (f).

notes.heading: “Secretary” Defined
notes.text: Secretary means the Secretary of the Army, see section 2 of Pub. L. 110–114, set out as a note under section 2201 of this title.
